parameters.query: SELECT id, name, phone_number, status, sms_sent, sms_date, category, registrar, registration_date, branch_id FROM records WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status)) = 'ready' AND LOWER(COALESCE(sms_sent::text, '')) NOT IN ('true', 't', 'yes', 'y', '1', 'sent', 'success') AND phone_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(phone_number) <> '' ORDER BY registration_date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT 100;

parameters.jsCode: const items = $input.all(); const results = []; const sandboxEnabled = String($env.ARKESEL_SANDBOX || '').toLowerCase() === 'true' || String($env.ARKESEL_SANDBOX || '') === '1'; for (const item of items) { const recordId = String(item.json.id ?? '').trim(); const phone = String(item.json.phone_number ?? '').trim(); const name = String(item.json.name ?? '').trim(); const message = `Hello ${name || 'customer'}, your case is ready. Please visit the office. Thank you.`; if (!recordId) { results.push({ json: { ...item.json, sms_message: message, sms_sent_candidate: false, sms_error: 'Missing record id.' } }); continue; } if (!phone) { results.push({ json: { ...item.json, sms_message: message, sms_sent_candidate: false, sms_error: 'Missing phone number.' } }); continue; } const apiKey = $env.ARKESEL_API_KEY; if (!apiKey) { results.push({ json: { ...item.json, sms_message: message, sms_sent_candidate: false, sms_error: 'Missing ARKESEL_API_KEY environment variable.' } }); continue; } const sender = $env.ARKESEL_SENDER_ID || 'RECORDS'; try { const response = await this.helpers.httpRequest({ method: 'POST', url: 'https://sms.arkesel.com/api/v2/sms/send', headers: { 'api-key': apiKey, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' }, body: { sender, message, recipients: [phone], ...(sandboxEnabled ? { sandbox: true } : {}) }, json: true }); const success = response?.success === true || response?.status === 'success' || Boolean(response?.messageId) || Boolean(response?.data?.messageId); results.push({ json: { ...item.json, sms_message: message, sms_sent_candidate: Boolean(success), sms_provider_response: response, sms_sandbox: sandboxEnabled } }); } catch (error) { results.push({ json: { ...item.json, sms_message: message, sms_sent_candidate: false, sms_error: error.message, sms_sandbox: sandboxEnabled } }); } } return results;

parameters.query: UPDATE records SET sms_sent = 'true', sms_date = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{$json.id}} AND LOWER(COALESCE(sms_sent::text, '')) NOT IN ('true', 't', 'yes', 'y', '1', 'sent', 'success') AND {{$json.sms_sent_candidate}} RETURNING id, sms_sent, sms_date;
